text:
olga: Taking the night shift tonight (starting 00:00 UTC). Doing a quick preflight — can folks confirm: VPN, bastion SSH, PagerDuty membership, AWS/KMS access, and runbook visibility? I'll run checks in ~30m. runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/oncall-night

sam: On it, I can double-check pager + SSH key stuff. ping me if you want me to test from my mac. :+1:

alex: Short checklist we always miss: 1) VPN connected, 2) SSH to bastion, 3) PagerDuty schedule, 4) AWS console + MFA, 5) KMS roles, 6) runbook open. I can run the VPN check now.

devops-bot: [provisioning] Checking oncall schedule membership... query: schedules/eng-oncall-weekend -> result: pending

sam: VPN ok from my laptop — connected to tunsrv-us-west, route 10.10.0.0/16 present. If you see no route, try `sudo route -n` or `ip route show`.

olga: Trying to ssh to bastion: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa_oncall bastion` -> "Permission denied (publickey)"

alex: That sounds like a key not added. @sam can you re-add olga's key to oncall-bastion? also check `~/.ssh/config` host entry and correct key path.

sam: Re-added olga's key to `oncall-bastion` at 16:30 UTC, fingerprint 3f:2a:7b. Try again.

olga: Success — SSH to bastion works now. Jumped to app-prod-01 with `ssh -J bastion app-prod-01` and got shell.

devops-bot: pagerduty: user olga added to schedule "eng-oncall-weekend" (id: sd_42).

jeremy: FYI double-check PD notification methods — some carriers block SMS. I enabled phone-call fallback for your PD contact method.

olga: SMS test failed (carrier block). I'll rely on phone-call fallback and enable push. Thanks @jeremy.

alex: Quick runbook smoke: trigger a synthetic alert using `curl -X POST https://internal-alerts.local/trigger -d '{"name":"smoke-high-latency"}'` or use `devops-tools trigger-alert smoke-high-latency`. I triggered it — Slack #incidents got the ping.

olga: Confirmed alert received, watching Grafana dashboard. Dashboards load and logs are streaming.

sam: Note for tonight: if you need to restart inference runtime use `kubectl -n runtime rollout restart deploy/inference-serving`. Do NOT restart `model-pool` pods unless instructed by eng-runtime — it can cause heavy coldstarts.

olga: Got it. Any scheduled deploys or known instability windows tonight?

alex: Prod deploy window is ~01:00 UTC for a small patch; EU-west nodes were patched earlier today so capacity might be reduced. Yesterday we saw a couple of OOM evictions during rolling updates — watch autoscaler events.

olga: I'll add alerts for `oom_kill` and `cpu_throttled` to my watchlist.

sam: If pager fires, DM me and I'll assist with escalations.

olga: Final KMS check: `aws kms list-keys --profile oncall` -> AccessDenied for me right now.

alex: Missing key policy for role `oncall-runner`. Adding `kms:ListKeys` to the role policy now.

alex: Policy change applied. Retry.

olga: KMS list works now. All green for KMS, SSH, VPN, PD, runbook access.

olga: Quick note for my handoff: I will monitor latency/failure alerts (alerting rules: latency_p99 > 3000ms, inference_errors > 0.5%). If anything pages, escalate to sam then alex. I'll post a short summary before I start shift.

devops-bot: reminder: scheduled handoff note in ~10m. :bell:

jeremy: Thanks all — appreciate the quick standby checks. :rocket:

olga: Thanks team, logging off this prep. Will update the runbook if anything else pops up.
